description: Manage customers, subscriptions, and recurring billing with Paddle Billing.

auth.description:

Live and sandbox keys are supported automatically.

You can create API keys from **Developer Tools > Authentication** in the Paddle dashboard.

list-customers.name: list-customers
list-customers.description: Lists customers from your Paddle account.

email.description: Optionally filter customers by exact email address.

limit.description: Maximum number of customers to return.

aiMetadata.description: Lists customers in a Paddle Billing account, returning all customers by default or filtering when an exact email and/or status (active/archived) is supplied. Use to look up a customer or enumerate the customer base; the email filter matches exactly, not partially. Read-only and idempotent.

get-subscription.name: get-subscription
get-subscription.description: Retrieves a Paddle subscription by ID.

subscriptionId.description: Select the Paddle subscription to use.

auth.description:
Authenticate with a Paddle API key.

Live and sandbox keys are supported automatically.

You can create API keys from **Developer Tools > Authentication** in the Paddle dashboard.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single Paddle subscription by its subscription ID (sub_...) to inspect its status, items, and customer. Use when you already have the subscription ID and need its current details. Read-only and idempotent.

update-subscription.name: update-subscription
update-subscription.description: Updates a Paddle subscription. Send the full recurring item list you want the subscription to keep.

subscriptionId.description: Select the Paddle subscription to use.

auth.description:
Authenticate with a Paddle API key.

Live and sandbox keys are supported automatically.

You can create API keys from **Developer Tools > Authentication** in the Paddle dashboard.

priceId.description: Select an active recurring Paddle price.

auth.description:
Authenticate with a Paddle API key.

Live and sandbox keys are supported automatically.

You can create API keys from **Developer Tools > Authentication** in the Paddle dashboard.

quantity.description: Optional quantity for the recurring price.

prorationBillingMode.description: How Paddle should bill for the subscription change.

customData.description: Optional JSON object to store on the subscription.

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Paddle subscription by ID, replacing its recurring item (price and quantity) and optionally setting custom data; the proration billing mode controls how the change is charged (immediately vs. next billing period, prorated or full, or not billed). Use to change a plan, quantity, or metadata on a live subscription. The items you send replace the subscription's recurring items rather than merge, and the call mutates the subscription on each run, so it is not idempotent.

cancel-subscription.name: cancel-subscription
cancel-subscription.description: Cancels a Paddle subscription immediately or at the next billing period.

subscriptionId.description: Select the Paddle subscription to use.

auth.description:
Authenticate with a Paddle API key.

Live and sandbox keys are supported automatically.

You can create API keys from **Developer Tools > Authentication** in the Paddle dashboard.

effectiveFrom.description: Choose when Paddle should apply the cancellation.

aiMetadata.description: Cancels a Paddle subscription by ID, applying the cancellation either immediately or at the end of the current billing period via the effective-from option. Use to end a subscription; this changes billing state and is not idempotent (repeating it on an already-canceled subscription will error or re-apply).

create-transaction.name: create-transaction
create-transaction.description: Creates a Paddle transaction. When you use recurring prices, completing the transaction starts the subscription.

customerId.description: Select the Paddle customer to use.

auth.description:
Authenticate with a Paddle API key.

Live and sandbox keys are supported automatically.

You can create API keys from **Developer Tools > Authentication** in the Paddle dashboard.

addressId.description: Select the Paddle address to bill against.

auth.description:
Authenticate with a Paddle API key.

Live and sandbox keys are supported automatically.

You can create API keys from **Developer Tools > Authentication** in the Paddle dashboard.

priceId.description: Select an active recurring Paddle price.

auth.description:
Authenticate with a Paddle API key.

Live and sandbox keys are supported automatically.

You can create API keys from **Developer Tools > Authentication** in the Paddle dashboard.

quantity.description: Optional quantity for the recurring price.

customData.description: Optional JSON object to store on the transaction.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new Paddle transaction for a customer against a recurring price (with optional quantity and custom data); since the price is recurring, completing the transaction begins the associated subscription. Requires a valid customer ID, billing address ID, and recurring price ID. Each call creates a separate transaction, so it is not idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description:
Authenticate with a Paddle API key.

Live and sandbox keys are supported automatically.

You can create API keys from **Developer Tools > Authentication** in the Paddle dashboard.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description:
Authenticate with a Paddle API key.

Live and sandbox keys are supported automatically.

You can create API keys from **Developer Tools > Authentication** in the Paddle dashboard.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

newActiveSubscription.name: newActiveSubscription
newActiveSubscription.description: Triggers when a subscription activates — a trial converts or the first payment succeeds.

aiMetadata.description: Fires on the Paddle subscription.activated event, when a subscription becomes active — for example a trial converts to paid or the first payment succeeds. Represents a newly live recurring subscription for a customer.

subscriptionCanceled.name: subscriptionCanceled
subscriptionCanceled.description: Triggers when a subscription is canceled — revoke access or notify support.

aiMetadata.description: Fires on the Paddle subscription.canceled event, when a subscription is canceled and its cancellation takes effect. Represents the end of a recurring subscription, useful for revoking access or notifying support.

subscriptionPastDue.name: subscriptionPastDue
subscriptionPastDue.description: Triggers when a subscription goes past due — start dunning flows or restrict features.

aiMetadata.description: Fires on the Paddle subscription.past_due event, when a subscription enters past-due status because a renewal payment was not collected. Represents a subscription at risk of cancellation, useful for dunning flows or restricting features.

transactionCompleted.name: transactionCompleted
transactionCompleted.description: Triggers when a transaction completes successfully — send a receipt or update records.

aiMetadata.description: Fires on the Paddle transaction.completed event, when a transaction is fully paid and finalized. Represents a successful payment/collection for a customer, useful for sending receipts or updating records.

paymentFailed.name: paymentFailed
paymentFailed.description: Triggers when a transaction payment fails — trigger retry logic or alert the customer.

aiMetadata.description: Fires on the Paddle transaction.payment_failed event, when a payment attempt on a transaction is declined or otherwise fails. Represents a failed collection for a customer, useful for retry/dunning logic or customer alerts.

pt.HEAD: CABEÇA
pt.Triggers when a subscription activates —: Aciona quando uma assinatura é ativada — um teste é convertido ou o primeiro pagamento é bem-sucedido.
pt.Triggers when a subscription is canceled: Aciona quando uma assinatura é cancelada — revoga o acesso ou notifique o suporte.
pt.Triggers when a subscription goes past d: Dispara quando uma assinatura passa em atraso - comece a dunar fluxos ou restrinja recursos.
pt.Triggers when a transaction completes su: Aciona quando uma transação é concluída com sucesso - envia um recibo ou atualiza registros.
pt.Triggers when a transaction payment fail: Aciona quando um pagamento de transação falhar — desencadeia lógica de repetição ou alerta ao cliente.
